_source: mc2_01 presentation the ABL doesn't drive yet: the opening camera flyby. Voice, comms videos and music come from the mission script (SimAbl abl_* events); every unit runs its original ABL brain.

script._doc: Camera flyby for the mission start, transcribed from mc2_01.abl (its movie-mode camera calls are not driven from ABL yet).

flyby._doc: mc2_01.abl l.193-207 and stages 1-8 (l.497-540): camera positions in world units; yaw is relative to the mission's StartRotation.
